## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
#| echo: false
library(tidyverse)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggpubr)
library(lamW)
source("plotting-utils.R")

dev_pdf <- function (filename, width, height, .path = "figures") {
  if (!dir.exists(.path)) {
    dir.create(.path, mode = '0755', recursive = TRUE)
  }
  if (isTRUE(capabilities('cairo'))) {
    cairo_pdf(file.path(.path, str_remove(basename(filename), coll("-1"))),
              fallback_resolution = 600,
              antialias = 'default',
              width = width,
              height = height)
  } else {
    pdf(file.path(.path, str_remove(basename(filename), coll("-1"))),
        width = width,
        height = height)
  }
}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width  = 6,
                      fig.height = 2,
                      out.width  = "100%",
                      dev        = c('png', 'dev_pdf'),
                      fig.ext    = c('png', 'pdf'),
                      echo       = FALSE,
                      warning    = FALSE,
                      error      = FALSE,
                      message    = FALSE)
```


```{r}
bridge_weights <- function (lr, type = c('klkl', 'hdhd', 'klhd'), alpha, gamma) {
  switch(match.arg(type),
         klkl = lr^alpha,
         hdhd = ((1 - alpha) + alpha * sqrt(lr))^2,
         klhd = {
           beta <- (alpha / (1 - alpha)) * sqrt(lr)
           b <- (beta / lambertW0(beta * exp(-gamma)))^2
           if_else(alpha < .Machine$double.eps | lr < .Machine$double.eps, exp(2 * gamma), b)
         }
  )
}

settings <- list(
  'paste("KL/KL")' = \(alpha) list(type = 'klkl', alpha = alpha),
  'paste("HD/HD")' = \(alpha) list(type = 'hdhd', alpha = alpha),
  'paste("KL/H", D[gamma==-2])' = \(alpha) list(type = 'klhd', alpha = alpha, gamma = -2),
  'paste("KL/H", D[gamma==0])' = \(alpha) list(type = 'klhd', alpha = alpha, gamma =  0),
  'paste("KL/H", D[gamma==+2])' = \(alpha) list(type = 'klhd', alpha = alpha, gamma = +2)
)
```

## As a function of $\rho$

```{r}
#| label: bw-fun-of-rho
alpha_seq <- c(0.01, seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.2), 0.99)
lr <- seq(0, 5, length.out = 501)

bws <- map_dfr(alpha_seq, \(a) {
  bw <- vapply(settings, FUN.VALUE = lr, \(s) {
    do.call(bridge_weights, c(list(lr = lr), s(a)))
  })

  tibble(alpha = a,
         lrv   = rep(lr, times = length(settings)),
         type = rep(names(settings), each = length(lr)),
         value = as.numeric(bw))
}) |>
  mutate(type = fct_inorder(type),
         alpha_str = sprintf("alpha%s%.2f", if_else(alpha > 1 - 1e-3, '%~~%', '=='), alpha) |>
           fct_inorder())
```

```{r}
#| label: bw-fun-of-rho-alphacol
bws |>
  filter(lrv > 0) |>
  group_by(type, alpha) |>
  mutate(value = value / value[[which.min(abs(lrv - 1))]]) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = lrv, y = value, color = alpha, group = factor(alpha))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(type), scales = 'free_y', labeller = 'label_parsed') +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = 'A', direction = -1,
                        end = 0.8) +
  plottheme(dark = F) +
  labs(x = "Likelihood ratio",
       y = "Bridge weight",
       color = expression(alpha))
```

```{r}
#| label: bw-fun-of-rho-typecol
pl_by_rho <- bws |>
  filter(lrv > 0) |>
  group_by(type, alpha) |>
  mutate(value = value / value[[which.min(abs(lrv - 1))]]) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(alpha %in% c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = lrv, y = value, color = type)) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = type), linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(alpha_str), scales = 'free_y', labeller = 'label_parsed') +
  scale_color_manual(values = unname(COLORPAL[c('black', 'orange', 'lightblue', 'green', 'blue')]),
                     labels = scales::parse_format()) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c('solid', '22', '41', '11', '3111'),
                        labels = scales::parse_format()) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 3.1)) +
  plottheme() +
  labs(x = "Likelihood ratio",
       y = "Bridge weight",
       color = NULL,
       linetype = NULL)
pl_by_rho
```


## As a function of $\alpha$

```{r}
#| label: bw-fun-of-alpha
alphas <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 501)
lr_seq <- c(0.1, seq(0, 5, length.out = 21))

bws_alpha <- map_dfr(lr_seq, \(lr) {
  a0 <- which.min(abs(alphas))
  bw <- vapply(settings, FUN.VALUE = alphas, \(s) {
    x <- do.call(bridge_weights, c(list(lr = lr), s(alphas)))
    x / x[[a0]]
  })

  tibble(alpha = rep(alphas, times = length(settings)),
         lr    = lr,
         type  = rep(names(settings), each = length(alphas)),
         value = as.numeric(bw))
}) |>
  mutate(type = fct_inorder(type),
         lr_str = sprintf("rho==%.1f", lr) |>
           fct_inorder())
```


```{r}
#| label: bw-fun-of-alpha-lrcol
#| fig-height: 3.3
bws_alpha |>
  filter(lr > 0) |>
  group_by(type, alpha) |>
  mutate(value_norm = value / value[[which.min(abs(lr - 1))]],
         value = log(value),
         value = if_else(value > 6, NA_real_, value)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(value, value_norm), names_to = "normalized", values_to = "bw") |>
  mutate(normalized = fct_recode(normalized, "Unnormalized (log)" = "value", "Normalized" = "value_norm")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = alpha, y = bw, color = lr, group = lr_str)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(type), rows = vars(normalized), scales = 'free_y',
             labeller = 'label_parsed') +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = 'A', end = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1),
                     labels = c('0', '0.5', '1')) +
  plottheme() +
  labs(x = expression(alpha),
       y = "Bridge weight",
       color = expression(rho))
```

```{r}
#| label: bw-fun-of-alpha-typecol
pl_by_alpha <- bws_alpha |>
  group_by(type, alpha) |>
  mutate(value = value / value[[which.min(abs(lr - 1))]]) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(lr %in% c(0.1, 0.5, 2, 4)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = alpha, y = value, color = type)) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = type), linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(lr_str), labeller = 'label_parsed') +
  scale_color_manual(values = unname(COLORPAL[c('black', 'orange', 'lightblue', 'green', 'blue')]),
                     labels = scales::parse_format()) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c('solid', '22', '41', '11', '3111'),
                        labels = scales::parse_format()) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1),
                     labels = c('0', '0.5', '1')) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 3.1)) +
  plottheme() +
  labs(x = expression(alpha),
       y = "Bridge weight",
       color = NULL,
       linetype = NULL)
pl_by_alpha
```
